notes.title: New update is live! Some fixes and improvements!
notes.notes: The monsters from waves 15, 25, 35, and 45 have undergone changes in health and damage, making the player experience more enjoyable. We have also adjusted the movement speed of some monsters to give the player more room to move!

notes.title: Western Shadowlands is Now Live!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Western Shadowlands is officially launched and ready for you to explore! Step into the boots of a gunslinger in this retro-styled roguelike set in the untamed Wild West. Prepare for procedurally generated challenges, intense combat, and a world filled with danger and mystery.

This is just the beginning of your journey! While the game is fully playable, we’re committed to expanding and improving it with future updates. Stay tuned for exciting new features, balance adjustments, and more content to make your adventure even better.

Thank you for joining us on this journey into the shadows of the Wild West. Let’s see how far your gunslinging skills can take you!

Good luck, and happy hunting!
